tutorials.title: Long-Tail Cast On
tutorials.summary: The most common way to start a knitting project.

steps.title: Leave a tail
steps.text: Pull out about one inch of yarn for every stitch you need, plus a few extra inches. Make a slip knot and place it on your needle.

steps.title: Hold the yarn
steps.text: Wrap the tail end around your left thumb and the working yarn around your left index finger. Hold both strands with your other fingers.

steps.title: Make the first stitch
steps.text: Bring the needle up through the loop on your thumb, catch the strand from your index finger, and pull it back through the thumb loop. Drop the thumb loop and tighten gently.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Keep going until you have the number of stitches your pattern asks for. Keep the tension even, not too tight.

tutorials.title: The Knit Stitch
tutorials.summary: Learn the basic knit (k) stitch, the foundation of garter stitch.

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: Hold the needle with the cast-on stitches in your left hand. Keep the working yarn behind the work.

steps.title: Insert
steps.text: Slide the right needle into the front of the first stitch on the left needle, from left to right.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Wrap the yarn counterclockwise around the tip of the right needle.

steps.title: Pull through
steps.text: Pull the loop through the stitch with the right needle and let the old stitch slip off the left needle.

tutorials.title: The Purl Stitch
tutorials.summary: The purl (p) stitch is the reverse of knit and creates ribbing.

steps.title: Bring yarn forward
steps.text: Keep the yarn in front of the work.

steps.title: Insert
steps.text: Slide the right needle into the front of the next stitch from right to left.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Wrap the yarn counterclockwise around the right needle, going over the top and then under.

steps.title: Pull through
steps.text: Draw the loop back through the stitch and slip the old stitch off the left needle.

tutorials.title: Basic Bind Off
tutorials.summary: Finish your knitting so the edge stays neat and does not unravel.

steps.title: Knit two
steps.text: Knit the first two stitches as normal.

steps.title: Pass over
steps.text: Insert the left needle into the first stitch you knitted and lift it over the second and off the needle.

steps.title: Knit one more
steps.text: Knit the next stitch so there is one stitch on the right needle again, then pass the previous one over it.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Repeat until one stitch is left. Cut the yarn, leave a tail, and pull it through the last loop.

tutorials.title: Magic Ring
tutorials.summary: Start amigurumi and flower projects with a tight, closed center.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Wrap the yarn around two fingers, leaving a tail of about six inches.

steps.title: Insert
steps.text: Insert the hook into the ring, catch the working yarn, and pull up a loop.

steps.title: Chain
steps.text: Chain the number of stitches your pattern asks for (usually one or two).

steps.title: Close the ring
steps.text: Work your stitches into the ring, then pull the tail to close it tightly.

tutorials.title: Single Crochet (sc)
tutorials.summary: The shortest and densest basic stitch, great for amigurumi.

steps.title: Insert
steps.text: Insert the hook into the next stitch, under both loops of the top.

steps.title: Yarn over
steps.text: Yarn over and pull up a loop. You now have two loops on the hook.

steps.title: Yarn over again
steps.text: Yarn over one more time and pull through both loops.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: You have one single crochet. Move to the next stitch and repeat.

tutorials.title: Double Crochet (dc)
tutorials.summary: Taller and more open than sc, so projects grow faster.

steps.title: Yarn over
steps.text: Yarn over before you insert the hook into the stitch.

steps.title: Insert and pull up
steps.text: Insert the hook into the stitch and pull up a loop. You have three loops on the hook.

steps.title: Two at a time
steps.text: Yarn over and pull through two loops, then yarn over and pull through the last two.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Move to the next stitch and repeat the same steps.

tutorials.title: Making a Granny Square
tutorials.summary: Build a square with corners using clusters and chain spaces.

steps.title: Start the center
steps.text: Make a magic ring, ch 3, then work 2 dc into the ring. Ch 2, and work (3 dc, ch 2) three times into the ring.

steps.title: Join the round
steps.text: Slip stitch to the top of the first ch 3 to close the round.

steps.title: Work the corners
steps.text: Slip stitch into the next chain space. Ch 3, then (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in the same space to make a corner.

steps.title: Continue around
steps.text: Ch 1, then (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in each corner space. Slip stitch to finish.

stitches.name: Knit
stitches.meaning: Insert the needle front to back, wrap, and pull through.

stitches.name: Purl
stitches.meaning: Insert the needle back to front, wrap, and pull through.

stitches.name: Knit two together
stitches.meaning: Knit two stitches as one, which decreases by one.

stitches.name: Stockinette stitch
stitches.meaning: Knit one row, purl the next. Smooth on one side.

stitches.name: Chain
stitches.meaning: The base stitch. Yarn over and pull through the loop.

stitches.name: Slip stitch
stitches.meaning: The shortest stitch. Used for joining rounds and moving.

stitches.name: Single crochet
stitches.meaning: Insert, yarn over, pull up, yarn over, pull through both loops.

stitches.name: Double crochet
stitches.meaning: Yarn over first, then pull up and work two loops off, twice.

patterns.title: Crochet Flower
materials: Worsted or DK cotton in two colors

steps.label: Round 1
steps.text: Make a magic ring. Ch 2, work 12 dc into the ring, sl st to the top of the first ch 2 to join.

steps.label: Round 2
steps.text: *Sl st into the next dc, ch 4, skip 1 dc.* Repeat from * 5 more times to make 6 loops. Sl st to join.

steps.label: Round 3
steps.text: In each ch-4 loop work (sc, hdc, 2 dc, hdc, sc) to make six petals. Sl st into the base to finish.

steps.label: Finish
steps.text: Cut the yarn, pull it through the last loop, and weave in the ends.

patterns.title: Garter Stitch Scarf
patterns.gauge: About 18 sts and 36 rows = 4 in in garter stitch

steps.label: Cast on
steps.text: Cast on 30 stitches using the long-tail cast on.

steps.label: Body
steps.text: Knit every row until the scarf measures about 60 inches, or until your yarn is almost gone. Leave enough yarn for the bind off.

steps.label: Bind off
steps.text: Bind off loosely using the basic bind off.

steps.label: Finish
steps.text: Weave in all ends and block lightly.

patterns.title: Ribbed Knit Hat
materials: US 7 (4.5 mm) 16 in circular needle for ribbing
US 8 (5.0 mm) 16 in circular needle for the body
patterns.gauge: About 20 sts = 4 in in stockinette stitch on US 8

steps.label: Cast on
steps.text: Cast on 80 stitches on the US 7 needle, join in the round, and place a marker.

steps.label: Ribbing
steps.text: Work k2, p2 ribbing for 2.5 inches (about 20 rounds).

steps.label: Body
steps.text: Switch to the US 8 needle. Knit every round until the hat measures 6 inches from the cast-on edge.

steps.label: Crown 1
steps.text: *K8, k2tog* around.

steps.label: Crown 2
steps.text: *K7, k2tog* around.

steps.label: Crown 3
steps.text: *K6, k2tog* around.

steps.label: Crown 4
steps.text: *K5, k2tog* around.

steps.label: Crown 5
steps.text: *K4, k2tog* around.

steps.label: Crown 6
steps.text: *K3, k2tog* around.

steps.label: Crown 7
steps.text: *K2, k2tog* around.

steps.label: Crown 8
steps.text: *K1, k2tog* around.

steps.label: Crown 9
steps.text: K2tog around.

steps.label: Finish
steps.text: Cut the yarn, leave an 8 inch tail, thread it through the last 8 stitches, and pull tight. Weave in the ends.

patterns.title: Simple Granny Square

steps.label: Round 1
steps.text: Magic ring, ch 3 (counts as dc), 2 dc, ch 2, (3 dc, ch 2) three times. Sl st to the top of the first ch 3.

steps.label: Round 2
steps.text: Sl st into the next ch-2 space. Ch 3, (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in the same space to make the first corner. *Ch 1, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in the next corner space.* Repeat from * two more times. Ch 1, sl st to the top of the first ch 3 to join. (4 corners)

steps.label: Finish
steps.text: Fasten off, weave in the ends, and join squares as needed.
